The MS2 phage is an internal positive control that serves as an extraction, reverse transcription, and qPCR positive control for each well. If only the MS2 phage amplifies, the sample is negative. If nothing amplifies (not even the MS2 phage control), this means that something went wrong with the extraction or with the RT-qPCR, and the sample is labelled as “invalid” and must be extracted again. This step will add 10 µL of MS2 to every well of the SEP except for the positive control well, A4. Add MS2 Phage to the SEP: If necessary, prepare the 1:160 diluted MS2 phage aliquots: Retrieve MS2 phage from the freezer and the nuclease-free water from benchtop storage. In a biosafety cabinet, make a 40 mL solution of 1:160 diluted MS2 phage in a sterile 50 mL conical tube by combining 39.750 mL nuclease-free water and 250 µL MS2 phage control (Thermo, PN: 100092698). Transfer 1.2 mL of the diluted MS2 phage solution from the 50 mL conical tube into sterile 2.0 mL microcentrifuge tubes labelled with "MS2" and the aliquot preparation date. This solution will make 33 aliquots. Store MS2 phage aliquots in the freezer at -80 °C . Thaw one aliquot of 1:160 diluted MS2 phage control. steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K in SEP
steps.instruction: Use the epMotion 5075 to transfer Proteinase K into KingFisher deep-well 96-well Sample Extraction Plates (SEP).

substeps.instruction: Turn on epMotion 5075 and open epBlue software (version 40.7).
Open 'Application Runner' and run program: Application_MVPII_ProK_10uL_1_Plate_210120_144344.export7
Place a box of 50 µL epTIPs in Position A2.

Label a clean 10 mL reservoir 'ProtK' and add 1.4 mL Proteinase K (MagMAX™ Viral/Pathogen II Kit, Thermo Fisher #A48383) into the reservoir; place in the left-most slot (Position 1) of the reservoir rack in Position B2.
Place a clean KingFisher 96-well deep-well plate (labeled with SEP barcode) in Position C2.
Run the program using 'Use required minimum volumes' and 'Detected tips' settings (uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed').

steps.title: Transfer Samples to SEP
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of each nasal swab sample into the SEP containing 10 µL Proteinase K using a Hamilton Microlab STAR or manually.

substeps.instruction: Wipe Hamilton deck and carriers with 70% EtOH.
Open 'Sample Transfer' software, enter number of samples/controls (max 480), and select Sample Source Type (bottom barcode for MTM, round barcode for Mawi, or round bottom for others).
Load 1000 µL filter tips into tip carriers.
Load sample tubes into 32-position carriers (starting from Deck Position 34, filling top to bottom).
Load SEPs into the plate carrier (well A1 in upper left).
Insert blank tubes containing 1 mL collection media into positions corresponding to SEP well H3 (positive control) and A4 (negative control).
Decap tubes and ensure barcodes face the right side of the racks.
Run the transfer program to move 200 µL from each tube to the SEP.
Remove SEPs, seal with aluminum plate seal using a roller, and recap sample tubes with PE Stopper Flange Caps (PN: 118127R).

steps.title: Prepare Binding Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a homogenous binding bead solution for the samples.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly vortex MVPII Binding Beads until no clumps adhere to the bottle walls.
Place a 100 mL epMotion reservoir in the Reservoir Rack (Position 1).
Add 27 mL of MagMAX Binding Solution (MagMAX™ Viral/Pathogen II Kit, Thermo Fisher #A48383) using a serological pipette.
Add 1020 µL of vortexed MVPII Binding Beads using a P1000 pipette.
Mix by pipetting up and down while moving the tip sideways until homogenous.

steps.title: Add Binding Beads to SEP
steps.instruction: Use the epMotion 5075 to add the binding bead mix to the SEP after samples have been added.

substeps.instruction: Load epMotion protocol: Application_MVPII_BindingBead_addition_to_SEP_1Plate_275uL_210120_144324.export7
Place a box of 1000 µL epTIPs in Position A2.
Place the reservoir rack in Position B2 with the 100 mL binding bead solution in the left-most slot (Position 1).
Place the SEP containing samples in Position C2.
Run the program using 'Use minimum required volumes' and 'Detected tips' settings (uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed').

steps.title: Add MS2 Phage Control
steps.instruction: Add MS2 phage control to the SEP using the epMotion 5075.

substeps.instruction: Place a box of 50 µL epTIPs in Position A2.
Label a clean 10 mL reservoir 'MS2' and place in the left-most slot (Position 1) of the reservoir rack in Position B2.
Transfer 1200 µL of thawed (1:160 diluted) MS2 phage aliquot into the 'MS2' reservoir using a P1000 pipette and filter tips.
Place the SEP containing samples and binding beads in Position C2.
Run the program using 'Use minimum required volumes' and 'Detected tips' settings (uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed').

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Use the epMotion 5075 to prepare the Wash, EtOH, and Elution plates.

substeps.instruction: Place a box of 1000 µL epTIPs in Position A2.
Place a reservoir rack in Position B2 with three reservoirs in the slots.
Place a clean KingFisher 96-well deep well plate labeled 'Wash Buffer' in Position C2.
Place a clean KingFisher 96-well deep well plate labeled 'EtOH' in Position C3.
Place a clean KingFisher 96-well deep well plate labeled with an 'REP' barcode in Position C4.
Run the program using 'Use minimum required volumes' and 'Detected tips' settings (uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed').
Verify final volumes: Wash Buffer plate (500 µL/well), EtOH plate (1000 µL/well), and REP plate (50 µL nuclease-free water/well).
Seal plates with transparent seals and a roller press if not proceeding immediately.

steps.title: Automated RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid purification using the KingFisher Flex instrument.

substeps.instruction: When prompted, load the Tip Comb Plate (place a fresh 'KingFisher 96 Tip Comb for DW Magnets' into a clean 96-well plate) and hit START.
Load the REP (Elution Plate), ensuring well A1 is in the upper-left corner, and hit START.
Load the EtOH plate and hit START.
Load the Wash plate and hit START.
Load the SEP (Sample Plate), ensuring well A1 is in the upper-left corner, and hit START.
Allow the instrument to process samples automatically.
When finished, remove the REP (each well should contain 50 µL purified RNA) and seal with AlumaSeal using a plate roller.
Remove and discard the SEP, Wash, and EtOH plates after pouring liquids into a chemical waste container.

steps.title: Compress RNA into 384-well Plate
steps.instruction: Compress up to four 96-well REPs into one 384-well RNA Working Plate (RWP) for RT-qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 1-4 REPs at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Turn on epMotion 5075 and load protocol: Application_4x96_1x384_bycolumn_compression_210120_144251.export7
Load 50 µL pipette tip boxes into positions A2, A3, A4, and A5 (one box per REP).
Place REPs into positions B2, B3, B4, and B5.
Load a clean, barcoded Bio-Rad Hard-Shell 384-well PCR plate (HSP3901) into position C4.
Remove seals from REPs and tip box covers.
Run the program using 'Use minimum required volumes' and 'Detected tips' settings (uncheck 'Check labware placement' and 'Check tube lid removed').
When prompted by the Process Control window, enter the number of samples for each REP (e.g., '96' for active plates, '0' for empty slots).
Execute the run to transfer 20 µL of each sample to the RWP.
Store the RWP at -80 °C after RT-qPCR.
